closure: Generation 66 published the generation-65 time-alignment diagnostic. Cold inspection found that its nearest-offset calculation mixed pandas integer datetime storage resolution with Timestamp.value nanoseconds, a known infrastructure regression class; therefore its ~-473k to -482k hour offsets are invalid evidence. Preserve the frozen R6 hypotheses. Run a deterministic resolution-safety regression test, then recompute and publish only the 2024/2025 timestamp diagnostic. Do not replay MT5 and do not access 2026 until the corrected diagnostic is reconciled.
